title: Alameda Point - USCG Appraisal
agency_path: GENERAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION.PUBLIC BUILDINGS SERVICE.PBS CENTRALIZED ACQUISITION SERVICES - CUSTOMER CONTRACTING BRANCH B
detail_text: The General Services Administration (GSA) intends to issue a solicitation for the Alameda Point USCG Appraisal under NAICS code 531320. This solicitation will be issued directly to at least three qualified sources. The anticipated date of issuance is 03/23/2026. Interested parties may contact Rhiannon Martin rhiannon.martin@gsa.gov for additional information. This notice is issued solely to inform potential offerors and does not constitute a solicitation.
